entries.title: Psalms 128:1
segments: . The temporal blessings of true piety. The eighth chapter of Zecariah is a virtual commentary on this Psalm. Compare

entries.title: Psalms 128:2
segments: 2. For thou shalt eat--that is, It is a blessing to live on the fruits of one's own industry.

entries.title: Psalms 128:5
segments: 5. In temporal blessings the pious do not forget the richer blessings of God's grace, which they shall ever enjoy.

entries.title: Psalms 128:6
segments: 6. Long life crowns all other temporal favors. As
, this Psalm closes with a prayer for peace, with prosperity for God's people.
